purpose: Canonical ownership map for overlapping repository datasets. One family may have multiple technical layers, but only one layer owns each kind of fact; indexes, evidence, graph projections and research waves reference rather than duplicate the owner.
rule: Canonical ownership is about authority for a record type, not about which file happens to be largest.

countries.policy: Each country has one canonical substantive record. Sourced observations, historical changes, relationships, research queues and provenance live in that record. The index owns identity; the blueprint owns reusable schema; nodes are graph projections. No separate country snapshot or enrichment overlay is canonical.

north_europe_economic.policy: north-europe-economic-network owns the domain records it declares for the North European economic network. System/sector/observation datasets are scoped views or evidence layers and must reference these records rather than create competing identities. Country files remain authoritative for country identity and country-level observations.

potatoism.policy: Dossiers own substantive readable concept content. The concept registry owns semantic identity and aliases. The canonical corpus preserves project-canon source material. Lexicons, cosmology, maps and timelines are projections/occurrences and resolve back to canonical IDs. Relationships are edges, not identities.

religion.policy: records.json owns tradition/formation identity and core descriptive records. Comparative, relationship and source files reference records. Adjacent records remain a distinct classification family.

extremism_movements.policy: The main atlas owns movement identity. Enrichment owns long-form dossiers. Classification datasets retain source-specific labels and must not overwrite canonical identity/status.

swamp.empirical_rule: Swamp is an analytical/relational layer over canonical people, organizations, money, media, security and cultural records.
swamp.policy: swamp-ecology owns ontology, entity types, relationship semantics, evidence levels and safety rules. Actual entities remain owned by their domain families.

research.policy: research.json owns durable research claims/facts and source-linked evidence. Expansion/frontier files define queues or candidate records. Research carvings are deep evidence-aware studies. None should silently duplicate a canonical node.

relationships.policy: relationships.json owns canonical cross-domain graph edges. Scoped relationship files may own domain-local research edges until promoted. Never maintain two authoritative copies of the same edge.

intelligence_security.policy: Organization file owns institutional identity and public facts. Country layer couples agencies to jurisdictions. Graph is derived relationship mapping. Wave file is research expansion and case analysis.

consolidation_actions: Build canonical-record-registry.json from actual record IDs without confusing inventory IDs with semantic concept IDs.
Resolve recurring Potatoism terms through potatoism-concept-registry.json.
Keep one substantive dossier per canonical Potatoism concept; put additional discoveries into that dossier rather than creating another shallow term file.
Treat lexicon/cosmology/map/timeline/relationship entries as occurrences, projections or edges and preserve source paths as provenance.
Mark deprecated/derived files explicitly before deleting anything.
Do not delete historical research waves until their unique information has been compared and migrated.
Run concept-integrity, source-of-truth, duplicate-ID, graph-orphan and route audits before deployment.
Resolve navigation by source file and exact JSON path; do not require every domain record to be copied into data/nodes.json.
